page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.2xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 8 vCPUs. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers weak single-core and multi-core CPU performance, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, memory read bandwidth for both small and large blocks falls within the average range, though large-block write bandwidth is weak. In application-specific tests, the instance achieves average performance in software compilation, ray tracing, image processing, and text processing. It also maintains average throughput for static web serving and Redis SET operations, but registers weak performance in database operations and cryptographic encryption tests.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute resources without virtualization-related resource sharing, but the older Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 architecture limits raw processing throughput compared to newer hardware generations. This makes the instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated cores and moderate memory capacity but do not demand high-performance compute or intensive database operations. It is suited for static web serving, basic text and image processing, and lightweight software compilation tasks, while being poorly suited for medium-to-large language model inference or heavy database workloads.
